section: MT-2 缓冲器准静态加载-缓释阻抗曲线：当前模型（容嘉欣图4(b) 查表+速度法） vs 文献读点 vs 旧模型冻结快照

protocol.compression_m: contact point (|e|=gap, x=0) to stroke 83 mm and back
protocol.vehicle_setup: x_front=0, v_front=0 fixed; x_back=e-free_length, v_back=+0.01 loading / 0 hold / -0.01 release

models.current: src/train_dynamics/coupler.py::coupler_force (2026-10-11 Rong2025 fl/fu table + velocity method): f = contact*(f0 - tanh(s_e*dv/eps)*half), eps=0.002, stiffness gain = stiffness/1.89e7; separation = F - f0 term
models.literature: Rong2025 Fig.4(b) digitalized MT-2 readpoints (400 dpi render, 500 kN/20 mm grid calibration, column-wise trace, +-30 kN reading error), f = f0 + sign(dv)*(fl-fu)/2 literal
models.previous: frozen snapshot of pre-2026-10-11 coupler_force: F0 + k*load_factor*x +- Stribeck(|dv|), dir tanh(dv/0.05); friction isolated by fric_amp->0 re-evaluation

loading_end_branch_separation_kn.note: F - midline f0 at the last loading point (|v|=0.01 m/s)

max_abs_dev_from_literature_kn.note: max |current - Rong2025 readpoints| over each branch; residual comes from contact ramp / gap / dv->0 midpoint

last_5mm_of_loading_delta_kn.note: F(83mm) - F(78mm) on the loading branch, |v| = 0.01 m/s

stop_at_83mm_v0_delta_kn.note: F(v=0 hold) - F(last loading point); velocity method returns to the midline f0 when motion stops

note: 装载缓释曲线按用户确认切换到容嘉欣2025 口径（学姐推荐文献）；旧模型以冻结快照形式保留在本归档供 before/after 对照。
